This '''battle''' was the culmination of the fight between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Desolous]]. The Jedi lured Desolous into a trap on the planet [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] and killed him and his [[Darth Desolous's army|army]] of [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'ans]].
